alternatives_rejected.why: frontend_latency-50 deviation (z=567.93) is smaller than productcatalogservice_latency-90 (z=955.44), and productcatalogservice's inbound calls slowed 2.42->202.98ms, so the delay originates downstream of frontend (E1, E2)
recommendationservice_latency-90 deviation (z=462.83) is less than half of productcatalogservice's, consistent with it inheriting delay from its productcatalogservice calls (E1, E2)

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice's network path (e.g., tc/netem rules or sidecar/network policy on its pod) and remove the injected latency; if it cannot be found quickly, reschedule the pod onto a healthy node; then confirm inbound p50 returns to about 2ms.
